claim: A record a seat keeps for a subagent under it is weighed against the body on disk only inside `akasha change subagent take`, and the weighing reads bodies alone, so nothing in a record tells work still wanted from work that has already landed by another route. A take reaches paths rather than subagents: every record naming a path it reaches is judged, and one record held back refuses the whole take and keeps no edit, so a record another subagent left at a shared path refuses a take that has nothing to do with it. Nothing else weighs the kept set. The list says of every record alike that whether it landed is undecidable, the sweep that runs on a timer only appends more, and no check judges the file. 608 records are kept beside the `thea` seat.

evidence:
Read 2026-09-15 at `8c600fb0344`.

WHAT THE WEIGHING ASKS. `verdictOf` at `command/pages/change/subagent/modules/subagent-edits-acting/subagent-edits-acting.module.code.ts:280-284` answers one of four — `takes`, `undecidable`, `landed`, `stale` — from two questions and no others: `leftAlready` at `:251-264`, whether the body already holds the text the record leaves, and `stepped` at `:272-278`, whether the record still fits the text it was drafted against. Both run over the bodies on disk with this agent's own kept edits replayed first, at `judgingRecords:286-300`. The wordings a refusal carries are `STALE` at `:211-213`, `LANDED` at `:207-209` and `UNDECIDED` at `:203-205`. A record holds `leftBy`, `carriedAt`, the edit and the raw line, at `KeptRecord:74-80`; `leftBy` is read at `:94` and reaches only `saidAbout` at `:113`, which prints it. So every verdict is a fact about text in the tree, and nothing weighed is a fact about whether that work is still wanted.

ONLY A TAKE ASKS. `verdictOf` and `judgingRecords` are private to that module, and `taken` at `:317-345` is their only caller. The three other readers of `recordsKept` weigh nothing: `listingRecords:116-120`, `showingRecords:136-146` and `dropped:163-179`. The list prints one blanket line over the whole file, `UNDECIDABLE` at `:63-64`, which is the departure at `change-subagent-list.command.ts:48`. Outside its own folder the module is imported by the four commands `list`, `show`, `drop` and `take` and by nothing else. No page under `check/` names the kept file or the `subagent-edits` property.

WHAT RUNS ON A TIMER ADDS. `sweep-subagent-pages.service-workstation.running.code.ts:10-18` calls `agentSubagentSweep` with `--remove`. That reaches `moving` at `agent-subagent-sweep.command.code.ts:211-218`, which calls `movedOnto`; `movedOnto` at `agent/subagent/modules/recovering/subagent-recovering.module.code.ts:157-173` appends a swept subagent's unlanded edits to the seat's file, stamped with `leftBy` and `carriedAt` by `editsSaid:130-132`. The one scheduled thing that touches the kept set feeds it.

A TAKE REACHES PATHS. `taken:327` selects with `namedIn(one.edit, paths)`, and `namedIn` at `command/modules/change-acting/change-acting.module.code.ts:146-149` matches on the path alone. `change-subagent-take.command.ts:47` states `Every record a path names is taken, so a chain of records over one path is taken whole`. At `:331-334` any record whose verdict is not `takes` sends the whole call to `mistaking`, and `landed` and `stale` are held back whatever `unlanded: true` says, which is the departure at `change-subagent-take.command.ts:90`.

SCALE. `agent/seat/pages/thea/thea.seat.subagent-edits.uncommitted.jsonl` held 608 lines at 2026-09-15 10:23, and `recordsKept:101-109` makes one record of each non-empty line.

WHAT IS NOT MEASURED HERE. `akasha change subagent list` run from a subagent answers that no records are kept: `change-subagent-list.command.code.ts:13` resolves `agentPathOf(root, agentId)`, the calling agent's own page, so only the seat itself lists what the seat keeps. The 608 is a line count rather than that command's own answer. Which subagents left those records, over how many distinct paths, and how the verdicts fall across them are unmeasured.

WHAT IS REPORTED RATHER THAN VERIFIED. The seat `astra` reports dropping ten kept records that were not stale but redundant: an `over` argument threaded through `treeUnder`, `treeUnentered` and `treeTracked`, and `underOver` made private, work that had landed by another route. The tree agrees that work is there — `treeUnder(root, folder, index, over)` at `change/modules/shadow-tree/change-shadow-tree.module.code.ts:75-84`, `treeUnentered` at `:86-91`, `treeTracked` at `:120-130`, and `underOver` at `:137` is exported by nothing. What verdict those ten would have drawn was not seen. She also reports three records against a page type `check/code/pages/file-has-its-page/`; no such folder is in the tree, and `check/code/pages/file-is-owned-by-a-page/` is.
